name: Request for IVF coverage details
goal: User asks if IVF treatments are covered and what the coverage limits are.
constraints: Bot must use only KB info, personalize reply, and cite the correct policy document and signed URL. No external info or filler.

testdata.query: Are IVF treatments covered under our group mediclaim? What are the limits?

phases.description: User asks about IVF coverage under group mediclaim.
